messages:
maria (AE): Quick sync — Xenon wants a 2-week POC. They plan to send us a custom 30B model variant and need it in the catalog + a dedicated test slot. Primary asks: KV cache compatibility, KMS for keys, and an estimate of incremental cost for a reserved GPU pool.

sam (Solutions Eng): noted. Do we have an internal checklist for 'custom model variant onboard'? I can kick off evals once model artifacts arrive.

jin (Infra): We do. Main blockers are tokenizer check and KV cache layout. If the model uses a different vocab we may need a tokenizer adapter. Also need model size & quantization target (fp16, int8).

maria (AE): I asked the customer; they said it's a Llama-like architecture, 30B, want int8. Tokenizer is custom with a ~50k vocab. They've shared a link to a tarball (private link) — will DM.

olivia (Security): For Private/Dedicated we need the security questionnaire answers before any artifact handoff. Key items: do they require BYOK with HSM-backed KMS? Also need data retention and inference logging controls clarified.

sam (Solutions Eng): Practical checklist I'm going to run through:
- tokenizer compatibility test
- KV cache memory profiling for seq len 2k/4k
- quantization accuracy sweep (fp16 vs int8)
- latency SLO smoke on a 1-GPU reserved node
- model signature + manifest validation

sam (Solutions Eng): I'll attach a quick command we'll run on the artifact once we have it:
```bash
redwood-toolkit model-validate --path ./xenon.tar.gz --expected-vocab 50000 
redwood-toolkit quantify --target int8 --out ./quant_results.json
```

jin (Infra): Notes on KV cache: custom tokenizer with long tail -> prefix cache footprint could increase ~20-40%. If the customer uses long context caching we may need to bump reserved pool memory or adjust batching. Also want to stress test our prefix cache eviction policy.

maria (AE): Pricing ask from customer: rough delta for reserved 1xA100-80G vs 2xA100-80G for the POC (2k RPS simulated, short bursts). They need a ballpark today for procurement.

jin (Infra): Ballpark: 1xA100-80G reserved monthly amortized to ~ $Xk/mo, 2x doubles. For an accurate quote I need expected sustained concurrency and batch sizes. If they plan long context + KV caching, memory may force 2x.

sam (Solutions Eng): I'll run a quick perf sim once we get the artifact. For planning: send a small prompt workload (50k tokens/day) and typical batch size (1-4).

olivia (Security): Also flag: if they require BYOK + HSM, we need legal + entitlements sign-off. Put that in the contract clause request now — slows timeline by ~2 weeks.

maria (AE): Understood. I'll ask Xenon to answer the security questionnaire and confirm BYOK. I'll also request a small sample corpus for evals and the workload profile.

deploy-bot: new-ticket created: M-1758002468 — xenon-poc-model-onboard (assign: sam, jin)

sam (Solutions Eng): Assigned. I'll draft a short onboarding runbook and a minimal test plan for the POC. Will post the runbook here once ready.

maria (AE): Thanks — timeline target: start artifact intake Mon (T+4). If security requires BYOK and legal shows up, we may shift to T+18. I'll keep everyone posted. :calendar: 

jin (Infra): Quick pro-tip: if they can't provide a tokenizer adapter, we can shim with a token-mapping layer but accuracy might drop. I'll add that as a fallback in the runbook.

sam (Solutions Eng): Good. I'll include fallback plan + quantization regression tests.

olivia (Security): For the questionnaire — I'll mark the sections we need answers to (data-inference logs, BYOK, external audit reports). Maria, send them to me privately and I'll call out any red flags.

maria (AE): Will do. Thanks all.

sam (Solutions Eng): Posting initial runbook draft now — <link to internal doc> (will paste summary here shortly).

maria (AE): Closing loop: can we aim for a short pre-POC call with Xenon + infra + security this week? 30 min to align on BYOK and tokenization.

jin (Infra): I'm available Wed 10-10:30 PT.

olivia (Security): Wed 10 works for me.

sam (Solutions Eng): Wed 10 for me too. I'll prep a 15-min checklist and perf expectations doc.

maria (AE): Great — I'll set calendar and update thread after the call. :thumbsup:
